strategic_audit.summary: Atlas Chief Strategy Planner has evaluated the 12 operational items across 7 sprint days for CloudPulse Systems. The plan rigorously coordinates 12 specialized agents (Atlas, Cadence, Compass, Courier, Echo, Herald, Muse, Quill, Sage, Scout, Veritas, Warden). All outbound actions are gated behind Veritas claim verification and Warden anti-spam checks.

audit_checks.detail: All daily sprints directly address core challenge 'Accelerate High-Intent Outbound & Pipeline Seeding' within the 'foundation' phase.
Wednesday Veritas audit prevents any unsubstantiated or hallucinated claims from entering Thursday drafts.
Compass establishes explicit margin guardrails on Monday before compute or outreach capital is allocated.
Warden verifies sender reputation, frequency limits, and time-zone quiet hours before Friday dispatch.
Courier is strictly configured with 'admin_required' approval policy. Nothing leaves without human sign-off.

strategic_directives: Maintain focus on verified ICP boundaries; do not expand into unvalidated segments during this week.
Ensure Wednesday Veritas audit is completed before reviewing Thursday Quill copy.
Human review scheduled for Friday morning to inspect Courier drafts before dispatch.

items.title: Strategic Foundation & Weekly ICP Boundary Definition
items.objective: Formulate the high-leverage weekly operational directives for CloudPulse Systems focused on solving: Accelerate High-Intent Outbound & Pipeline Seeding.
acceptance_criteria: Explicit revenue and qualification thresholds defined
Target company employee tiers specified (100-2,000 employees)
Atlas state machine phase boundaries calibrated

items.title: Unit Economics & CAC Feasibility Thresholds
items.objective: Model target customer acquisition cost ceiling and minimum contract value boundaries before compute spend.
acceptance_criteria: Target CAC modeled under $450/SQL
Gross margin guardrail set at >= 78%
Minimum contract value hurdle verified

items.title: Competitor Vulnerability Audit & Target Account Discovery
items.objective: Scan live signals in B2B SaaS / DevOps & Observability for accounts experiencing infrastructure migration or tooling friction.
acceptance_criteria: At least 10 high-fit enterprise accounts verified
Key technical stakeholders identified (VP Eng, Head of Infra)
Competitor displacement hooks identified

items.title: Account Timing & Buying Intent Scoring
items.objective: Evaluate timing signals, hiring velocity, and microservices triggers to score accounts 0-100.
acceptance_criteria: All accounts assigned numerical priority score
Clear ACT/WAIT/DISQUALIFY rationale documented
Outreach timing window assigned

items.title: Proof Asset Audit & Claim Ground Truth Verification
items.objective: Audit case studies, benchmark claims, and customer quotes. Zero unverified claims permitted.
items.deliverable: Verified Claims Ledger & Risk Flag Report
acceptance_criteria: 100% of factual assertions referenced against ground truth
Numerical claims verified against telemetry logs
Zero unsupported claims allowed to pass to copywriting

items.title: Value Proposition Pillars & Persona Messaging Guide
items.objective: Craft core messaging pillars strictly referencing Veritas verified proof assets.
acceptance_criteria: 3 core value pillars tailored to DevOps leaders
Objection handling angles documented for common friction points
Tone calibrated to senior technical decision-makers

items.title: Personalized High-Conversion Outreach Copywriting
items.objective: Generate tailored 3-touch outbound email sequences referencing verified pain points and ground-truth citations.
acceptance_criteria: Concise, high-clarity copy under 120 words per email
One clear, frictionless call to action
Unsubscribe and opt-out mechanism built-in

items.title: A/B Campaign Experiment Architecture
items.objective: Structure message variant allocation and testing hypotheses to measure open and reply velocity.
acceptance_criteria: Variant A and Variant B testable hypotheses registered
Statistical sample size verified against Warden caps
Success metric locked to qualified meeting conversion

items.title: Anti-Spam, Frequency Caps & Domain Protection Check
items.objective: Audit staged messages against sender domain reputation policies, rate limits, and quiet hours.
acceptance_criteria: Anti-spam frequency caps verified
Timezone quiet hours enforced
Opt-out suppression lists checked

items.title: Calibrated Outbound Dispatch (Human-in-the-Loop Consensus)
items.objective: Deliver verified outbound messages to approved recipients following explicit human authorization.
items.deliverable: Outbound Dispatch Receipt & Lead Status Update
acceptance_criteria: Strict mandatory admin approval required before send
Delivery gateway receipt recorded
CRM synchronization completed

items.title: Inbound Response Classification & Intent Triage
items.objective: Classify incoming prospect replies, detect meeting requests vs objections, and alert human team.
acceptance_criteria: All replies categorized (interested, question, objection, unverified)
Escalation alerts dispatched for interested buyers
Draft contextual responses generated

items.title: Weekly Operations Retrospective & Learning Synthesis
items.objective: Synthesize win/loss patterns, reply metrics, and deliver calibrated strategy priors for next week.
acceptance_criteria: Calculated reply rate and interest velocity
At least 2 concrete strategic optimizations extracted
Priors updated for next week's Atlas plan
